"""Slug generation."""

import string

_ALLOWED = set(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits + " -")


def slugify(title):
    """Convert a title into a URL-friendly slug."""
    title = title.lower()
    title = title.replace("&", " and ")
    title = "".join(ch for ch in title if ch in _ALLOWED)
    title = "-".join(title.replace("-", " ").split())
    title = title.strip("-")
    if len(title) > 40:
        title = title[:40].rstrip("-")
    return title


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    print(slugify(" ".join(sys.argv[1:])))
